pt.headline: Nazaré oferece ondas perfeitas e vento leve hoje
pt.advice: Ondas de 1.3 m com período de 9 s e vento de 2 kt garantem sessões consistentes. A água está em 16.6 °C, use fato 3/2 mm. Não há avisos costeiros ativos, mas surfe com atenção ao mar.
pt.crowdTip: Chegue cedo para garantir seu pico antes da lotação.

en.headline: Nazaré serves perfect waves with light wind today
en.advice: 1.3 m waves at 9 s and a 2‑kt wind provide consistent rides. Water is 16.6 °C, wear a 3/2 mm wetsuit. No coastal warnings are active, but stay aware of the sea.
en.crowdTip: Get there early to claim your peak before the crowd builds.
en.moonTideLine: Waxing crescent · Spring tides · low tide 12:00

spots.name: Supertubos
spots.ptReason: Boa onda e vento leve, porém há avisos de interação com animais marinhos (ANAV NR 12/24, ANAV NR 2257/26).
spots.enReason: Good waves and light wind, but coastal warnings for marine animal interaction (ANAV NR 12/24, ANAV NR 2257/26).

spots.name: Guincho
spots.ptReason: Condições semelhantes a Supertubos, com avisos de interação e avistamento de animais marinhos (ANAV NR 1445/26, ANAV NR 1727/26).
spots.enReason: Similar conditions to Supertubos, with warnings for marine animal interaction and sightings (ANAV NR 1445/26, ANAV NR 1727/26).

spots.name: Nazaré
spots.ptReason: Ondas consistentes, vento fraco e sem avisos costeiros – ideal para surfar.
spots.enReason: Consistent waves, light wind and no coastal warnings – ideal for surfing.

spots.name: Ribeira d'Ilhas
spots.ptReason: Boa onda, mas vento de 5 kt e aviso de avistamento de animais marinhos (ANAV NR 1727/26).
spots.enReason: Good wave, but 5‑kt wind and a marine animal sighting warning (ANAV NR 1727/26).

spots.name: Coxos
spots.ptReason: Ondas ótimas e vento leve; porém há aviso de avistamento de animais (ANAV NR 1727/26).
spots.enReason: Great waves and light wind; however there is a marine animal sighting warning (ANAV NR 1727/26).

spots.name: Arrifana
spots.ptReason: Condições boas, mas atenção ao Plano de Salvamento Marítimo Lagos (ANAV NR 2/22).
spots.enReason: Good conditions, but heed the Lagos Maritime Rescue Plan warning (ANAV NR 2/22).

spots.name: Carcavelos
spots.ptReason: Ondas menores e múltiplos avisos de interação com animais marinhos (ANAV NR 00/14, 1445/26, 2235/26).
spots.enReason: Smaller waves and several marine animal interaction warnings (ANAV NR 00/14, 1445/26, 2235/26).
